description: Command shapes that make a model call through a command-line tool. A shell command is split into its parts at ;, &&, || and |; in each part, leading VAR=value assignments and an 'env' are passed over, and the next word is the program. A part is a call when its program's name is one listed here, it carries one of the entry's call markers (a flag anywhere, or a subcommand as the first argument), and it carries none of the words under not_a_call. The match is on the program run, so a command that runs a script which itself calls a model is not matched here: such a script writes its own records.
